oneOf.description: One guarded input followed by semantic observation and replanning. No effect predicate, verified progress, or following step. predicate.description: Every effect requires kind and that kind's fields. Node effects use an observed node_id; only step.expect may use $target.

oneOf.description: Verify keyboard focus on this exact observed node (focused=true), which may be a child of the foreground window. Being the active window or receiving a click does not establish keyboard focus. Use the focus action only on a target advertising focus; for typing, target the actual editable control and verify its value separately. This predicate does not verify click success or task completion.

Verify that the exact role=window node equals current scope.id: foreground activation, independent of its focused flag. Pair switch_window with this predicate for window activation. An already active window needs no activation input; this predicate alone gives no mutation or whole-task progress credit.

step.description: Argument-bearing verbs require args and their exact fields. Zero-argument verbs may omit args or use {}. Every expect entry requires kind.

step_args.description: Match args exactly to verb: set_value/value, type_text/text, set_checked/checked, select/option, scroll/direction, key_chord/keys, drag_drop/to_node_id, select_text/start+end; other verbs use {}.

keys.description: Individual key tokens, for example ["Control_L","a"] or ["Escape"]. Never combine a chord into "ctrl+a".

target.description: Use at least one observed node_id, role, or name; an empty target or scope_id alone is invalid.
